note: The Astor Study Editions. Contents are taken from each edition’s own published title and description; nothing is listed that the edition does not state.

/study/macbeth/.title: Macbeth
/study/macbeth/.author: William Shakespeare
description: The Astor Study Edition of Macbeth is written for students at school and university. It contains the full text of the play, with line numbers, a summary of every scene, explanatory notes, context, key quotations and analysis written for GCSE and A-level.
It gives particular attention to ambition, responsibility, equivocation, gender, imagery, character and performance.
contents: The full text of the play, with line numbers
Analysis written for GCSE and A-level

/study/hamlet/.title: Hamlet
/study/hamlet/.author: William Shakespeare
description: The Astor Study Edition of Hamlet is written for students at school and university. It contains the full text of the play, line-by-line notes, a guide to the context, character analysis, key quotations, what critics have argued and guidance for exams.
It gives particular attention to revenge, delay, proof, theatre, corruption, mortality, Ophelia and the soliloquies.
contents: The full text of the play

/study/othello/.title: Othello
/study/othello/.author: William Shakespeare
description: The Astor Study Edition of Othello is written for students at school and university. It contains the full text of the play, commentary on each scene, context, themes, character profiles and what critics have argued.
It gives particular attention to jealousy, race, military honour, evidence, language, character and performance.
The commentary sets notes on Shakespeare’s methods and key quotations beside the account of each scene, with example sentences for essays.
contents: The full text of the play
